title: WASD Character
cue: third-person character: run, jump, stairs, clips, camera
summary: A third-person character in one node: camera-relative movement, a forgiving jump, stairs taken in stride, feet placed on steps and slopes, animations paced so feet do not slide, and an orbit camera.
useWhen: The player, an enemy, or a companion is a character on foot in a 3D game: a third-person adventure, an action or exploration game, a platformer with a humanoid. With universal-animation-library a retargeted human walks, runs, and jumps with no animation code.
avoidWhen: A first-person game, which starter-kit-fps starts, a vehicle, or a 2D game; or a character that moves on a grid or by clicks, which a few lines do.
